content.title: About
content.content: Boiled, ready-to-heat potato is pre‑cooked potato packaged in single‑serve portions. It retains its natural flavor and texture, and after a quick microwave or stovetop reheating it is ready to eat within minutes.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Potato is one of the world’s most consumed vegetables, grown in over 100 countries.
Boiled potatoes retain a high amount of vitamin C when not over‑cooked.
Ready‑to‑heat potatoes are popular in cafeterias, office canteens and as a quick side dish at home.
When stored properly (refrigerated up to 5 days) the product stays fresh and tasty.
Potatoes contain resistant starch, which can support a healthy gut microbiome.

items.title: Source of complex carbohydrates
items.content: Potatoes provide slowly digestible carbs that give lasting satiety.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Boiled potatoes keep vitamin C, an antioxidant that supports the immune system.

items.title: Contains potassium
items.content: Potassium helps regulate fluid balance and supports normal heart function.

items.title: Provides dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber aids digestion and may help lower cholesterol levels.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Potatoes contain virtually no fat, making them suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: Potato allergy
items.content: A small number of people may experience allergic reactions to potato.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: If salt is added to the package, monitor sodium intake, especially for those with hypertension.

items.title: Bacterial growth if improperly stored
items.content: Storing above 4 °C for more than 5 days can allow bacterial proliferation.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: Potatoes have a high glycemic index, so people with diabetes should control portion size.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the package in the microwave (2–3 minutes) or on the stovetop, then add butter, herbs or spices to taste. It works well as a side for meat, fish, or in salads.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep refrigerated at 0‑4 °C, up to 5 days after opening. Do not freeze. Discard if it develops an off‑odor or discoloration.
